title: anotis boerhavioides
intro: Anotis boerhavioides, commonly known as Mexican tea, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Anotis boerhavioides include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, among others.
